Name: Haymaker
Author: ThatBritishMo
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardew Valley Haymaker

[/b][/size][size=4]Gone are the days of needing to build a silo, scythe grass, or find Marnie for hay. [/size]
[size=4]With the Haymaker, you can turn any item in the game (that you can hold), into hay. [/size]
[size=4]Stone hay? Fiber hay? Wood hay? PRISMATIC SHARD HAY? You got it. [/size]

[size=4]It takes stacks too... drop in 999 sap and watch it make 999 hay in seconds.[/size]

[size=4]The Haymaker recipe unlocks at farming level 3 and costs 10 copper bars, 100 wood, and 100 stone to make. [/size]

[b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/b]
[size=4]Requires SMAPI[/size]
[size=4]Requires Content Patcher[/size]
[size=4]Unzip the contents into your StardewValley\Mods\ folder[/size]
